Welcome back to Tales of Terra-Nova! Last session we fought Heskel and Asphodel of Arkonia, after coming to a peaceful resolution, we returned to Castle Ikaris. WE talked about our discoveries in The White Tower, and slept for a while waking up on the morning of the grand tournament! Maple and Vivienne had their due and after a tough battle Maple was able to rise above her injury and win! We met Augustus, Prince of the Freehold, and Ivys had an enticing interaction with Damion Syrell.

Now we return to the tournament, the air is cold and the ground is covered in frost as we enter the deeper seasons of this many years long winter. Maple rushes to the stands as you all applaud and she proudly peers up at you all, "You saw that? The parry you taught me worked perfectly." "Now all we have to do is kill Ivar, and reclaim my birthright."

Maple makes her way along with one of the healers from the Hyperion Church, back to the tent to deal with her injuries.
